articles.title: Orioles at Cardinals discussion
articles.summary: The O’s begin a nine-game road trip with a stop in St. Lous, where Chris Bassitt will toss the opener.
articles.body:
If the Orioles are going to make a push for the playoffs in this final month or so of the season, they are gonna have to win a bunch of games. That means beating solid teams like these Cardinals on the road. It's not gonna be easy.

It's a left-handed starter on the mound for St. Louis , Matthew Liberatore . That might be good news for the Orioles. They have been much improved against southpaws in recent months. As usual, Coby Mayo takes a prominent spot in the lineup, batting clean-up. He has a 1.105 OPS against lefties this year and has been pretty darn good overall in the second half, owning an .854 OPS since the all-star break.

Chris Bassitt will look to make it a third straight decent start since being activated from the IL. He has given up five runs over 11 innings since he returned from his back problems. After the off day on Monday the entire Orioles bullpen should be available, but it would still be nice to see Bassitt go a bit deeper here.

Let's start this nine-game road trip on a high note!

articles.title: 23 Unbelievably Dumb Things Husbands Said
articles.summary: "My husband thought that women wear white when they are on their period because that’s what they do in feminine hygiene commercials."
articles.body:
We asked members of the BuzzFeed Community to share the dumbest thing someone they know said. Soooooo many people shared stupid things their husbands said, so, of course, I compiled the funniest ones. Enjoy:

1. "My favorite dumb thing my husband said (when I was pregnant) is that he thought babies don't wear diapers when they sleep. After laughing for a bit, I told him they still pee and poo in their sleep. He said he knew that, but he thought they wore a special nightgown or something in their sleep instead. I think he thought that's what sleep sacks were for."

2. "I was planning a trip to Los Cabos in Mexico with my ex-husband (when we were married). My then-husband asked if I knew how to speak Mexican in addition to Spanish. I looked at him like, 'Did you really just say that?' Here is a guy who is incredibly smart, runs a hedge fund, and has an MBA from a top business school, and he honestly thought in Mexico they spoke Mexican. I was dumbfounded."

Related: "21 Divorced Women Share The Moment Their Husband Finally Broke Them"

3. "My husband thought it was stupid that I was trying to teach our dog to shake hands because she's a girl and 'only boys shake hands.' Who did I even marry?"

4. "On our wedding night, my ex-husband asked, 'What does terminated mean?' Yup, we were 18 years old, pregnant, and I was the only one with a job."

5. "Bank debit cards were a fairly new concept. I got an overdraft notice from the bank. My ex-husband said it was no problem, we could just go to the ATM and withdraw money to deposit in our checking account. I had to explain the ATM did not just dole out free money; every transaction deducted from our account. He was stunned."

6. "My husband thought that women wear white when they are on their period because that's what they do in feminine hygiene commercials."

7. "My ex-husband saw a Tampax commercial on TV and said, 'They're advertising those when they know women are having their periods.' I had to explain that we were not all on the same schedule."

8. "In the airport, taking my (now ex) husband on a business trip to California with me, he couldn't understand why I was setting my watch back three hours. When I explained time zones to him, he argued with and laughed at me. He refused to believe me until he saw the clocks when we landed."

9. "My husband and I were discussing our neighbor, who just got diagnosed with prostate cancer, and my husband said that he should probably get his prostate examined. Then he looked at me and said, 'Hon, you should probably get your prostate checked, too!' I told him that women don't have prostates."

Related: "People Are Exposing The "Crush Killers" That Make Them Hate Someone"

10. "My first husband and I went to my cousin's house to watch the first moon landing on TV. On the way home, he asked me if I thought we would ever see a man land on the sun."

11. "My ex-husband asked how the rice multiplies in the pot when it cooks. He thought it multiplied."

12. "My husband claimed he could just open the window to 'dust' his office."

13. "When my husband and I were trying to have a baby, I told him, 'I got my period, but we'll keep trying.' He said, 'How do you know you're not pregnant? Did you take a test?'"

Related: "Women Reveal How Their Cheating Partners Were Exposed After Visiting Their Home"

14. "I once told my husband I was going to make banana bread. He looked at me completely confused and asked how that was possible since we didn't have any bread. He thought that pieces of bread went into the batter."

15. "My husband didn't know that butterflies and moths are caterpillars transformed."

16. "My husband got in a fight with Alexa because she would not answer his question. The question? 'Alexa, who is the governor of your state?' Without telling her which state. Poor Alexa was so confused!"

17. "My husband at the time, now ex, was locked inside the car. Yes, you read that correctly, INSIDE. I had to hit the unlock on the key fob because he couldn't figure out how to get out. I kid you not, this actually happened."

18. "When my husband saw a bumper sticker that said 'FREE TIBET,' he asked, 'What's a tibet?'"

19. "My ex-husband asked me what the capital of Chicago was."

Related: "Your Dating Priorities Will Reveal Your True Romantic Type"

20. "A buddy of my husband's once spilled a little bit of plain water on a carpet. He went, 'Oh no! Is it gonna stain?!'"

21. "My husband and I rented a convertible while on vacation in Hawaii. He was in a hurry, but I told him we had to wait a little while because I had to put sunscreen on the kids. He said not to bother because once in the car, we would be moving."

22. "My 49-year-old husband has complained multiple times about pain he was having in his 'rotary cup.' He's essentially a borderline bodybuilder; he should know it's actually a 'rotator cuff.'"

23. And finally, "My husband pronounces the S in Illinois."

Submissions have been edited for length and/or clarity.

articles.title: Philadelphia Eagles’ QB Battle Gets Intriguing Update After Patriots Game
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles‘ QB2 battle is under a microscope this offseason, as the team has struggled to pick between Andy Dalton and Tanner McKee. After a Wee...
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles ' QB2 battle is under a microscope this offseason, as the team has struggled to pick between Andy Dalton and Tanner McKee .

After a Week 2 loss against the New England Patriots in the NFL preseason, there just might be a bit of a breakthrough.

When the Eagles linked for practice on Monday, August 24, Tanner McKee was utilized as the first Jalen Hurts backup, a position that Dalton has held for most of the offseason.

GettyFOXBOROUGH, MASSACHUSETTS – AUGUST 22: Andy Dalton #14 of the Philadelphia Eagles looks on in the first quarter against the Philadelphia Eagles during a preseason game at Gillette Stadium on August 22, 2026 in Foxborough, Massachusetts. (Photo by Caleb Bowlin/Getty Images)

"Tanner McKee was first up as QB2 today," Brandon Lee Gowton of Bleeding Green Nation wrote on Monday .

"Nothing overly flashy but a lot of shorter completions. Felt like the ball rarely hit the ground when he was out there. Andy Dalton did have a good completion to Moore along the sideline. No major movement in this battle today."

GettyBALTIMORE, MD – AUGUST 15: Tanner McKee #16 of the Philadelphia Eagles hands the ball off to Will Shipley #28 during the first half of the preseason game against the Baltimore Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium on August 15, 2026 in Baltimore, Maryland. (Photo by Scott Taetsch/Getty Images)

Before the first week of the preseason, Dalton seemed to be in front. He was picking up most of the QB2 reps. After Game 1 in Baltimore, there wasn't any movement. Both quarterbacks struggled within the offense.

Week 2 was a different story. Dalton struggled as the starter against the New England Patriots. McKee came in and thrived.

After the game, Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni claimed that the battle was still ongoing, but there seems to be a little more intrigue with McKee at QB2 this week.

GettyPHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA – JANUARY 04: Tanner McKee #16 of the Philadelphia Eagles warm ups prior to the game against the Washington Commanders at Lincoln Financial Field on January 04, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images)

âThe reason Andy is going in first is because heâs not going to play as much as Tanner because he has more experience and he has more experience within this type of system, and Tanner needs to continue to play there,â Sirianni said after the game.

âI think you saw the improvements there from Tanner. We got to continue to give both of them opportunities within practice and potentially games. Weâll see how both games go. Obviously, Iâm not there yet [for next weekâs game]. But obviously, that was the plan today.â

The Eagles will close out their preseason on Friday against the Cincinnati Bengals . It seems there is a chance that McKee could get the starting nod.
